lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in four to five discernible horizontal rows along the visible mid-lateral flank, forming a semi-regular grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows, creating anchor nodes where high-intensity maxima are centered.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges on the dorsal-lateral surface characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity luminance on the ridge crest to low-intensity shadow immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Multiple discrete high-luminance blobs are distributed across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration toward the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The second dorsal fin displays a markedly lower luminance profile and an absence of circular pattern features compared to the primary dorsal fin and surrounding flank.
